# Atropos
> Integrated technology for Tasmanian homes and businesses — Hobart, Tasmania, Australia

## About
Atropos designs and installs integrated technology across residential and commercial projects in Tasmania: home theatre, multi-room audio visual, unified communications and meeting rooms, digital signage, networks and Wi-Fi, automation, and managed services. We work with homeowners, business owners, builders and architects. Parent company: Atropos Industries Pty Ltd, Hobart, TAS 7000.

## Services

### Residential
- Home Theatre: Bespoke design, acoustic treatment, Dolby Atmos installation, 4K laser projection, and professional calibration for dedicated cinemas and media rooms.
- Audio Visual: Multi-room audio (Bluesound, Sonance, KEF, Bowers & Wilkins), living-area displays, outdoor sound and screens, and streaming sources on one control surface.
- Network & Wi-Fi: Enterprise-grade whole-home Wi-Fi and structured cabling using Ubiquiti UniFi, Ruckus, and Cisco Meraki.
- Smart Home Automation: Whole-home integration of lighting, climate, blinds and entertainment, integrating with the security provider a client already has. Specialists across RTI, Control4, Crestron and other major platforms rather than tied to any one of them, with custom mobile, tablet and web interfaces where a project calls for it. New builds and retrofits.

### Commercial
- Unified Communications: Microsoft Teams and Zoom meeting rooms, video conferencing, hybrid and BYOD spaces, room booking, and integration with the telephony platform a business already runs.
- Digital Signage & Audio Visual: Signage and displays, video walls, content scheduling, zoned audio and paging for workplaces and venues.
- Network & Wi-Fi: Networks monitored and patched on a schedule, segmented so a compromised device cannot reach the rest of the business.
- Managed Services: Proactive monitoring and scheduled maintenance, with response times scoped per site.
- Automation: Scheduling, occupancy sensing and multi-tenant zoning for offices, retail and hospitality — lighting, climate and AV governed from one system across floors and tenancies.

## Service Area
All of Tasmania — Hobart, Launceston, Devonport, Burnie and everywhere between. Based in Hobart.
